title: Collision-Free Is Not Enough: Passage-Conditioned Navigation for Wheeled-Legged Robots
title_zh: 仅无碰撞还不够：面向轮足机器人的通行条件约束导航（Passage-Conditioned Navigation）
abstract_en: A collision-free detour can still bring a legged robot to the next stair or ledge a few centimetres or degrees off, and a fixed locomotion skill, factory or learned, can stall or fall. Existing methods prevent this with a robot model or extensive trial and error, but on a new site with unknown skills neither is available, so they cannot be used. We find that a single 27-minute teaching session already supplies what these methods have to derive or learn: for every stair and ledge, one crossing the skill has completed. Our method, passage-conditioned navigation, makes the route remember how each transition was entered, not only where the path went. It stores each taught crossing as an event and, without training or a robot model, enforces it after every local replan: before each ledge, an entry gate makes the robot turn or back up and retry if it is more than 10 cm or 10° off the taught crossing. Under localization noise, with path, gait schedule, and sensing unchanged, this raises the share of disturbed ledge crossings that stay within these limits from 24.1% to 88.6%. In contact simulation with our learned policies, a robot pushed off course before stairs never falls in 180 climbs, against 9 falls when the stored direction is ignored; pushed 1.2 m away, it rejoins the route, ending on average 0.14 m from it (1.10 m without rejoining), and finishes as often as an undisturbed robot. This suits any robot with fixed skills that repeats a route over terrain transitions, as in inspection and patrol, where one wrong entry can end the task. We deployed it in competition on a real wheeled-legged robot: over 271 m of multi-obstacle terrain spanning 7.0 m of elevation, it completed all six runs, won third place at the 2026 Global Open-source AI Challenge, which drew 2,999 submissions, and was the only finalist in its task to finish fully autonomously.
abstract_zh: 对依赖固定运动技能的轮足机器人而言，无碰撞绕行并不保证安全通过楼梯或台沿：几厘米的位置偏差或几度的朝向偏差，就可能导致机器人卡住或跌倒。本文提出通行条件约束导航（passage-conditioned navigation），通过一次 27 分钟的示教，为每处楼梯和台沿记录一次成功通过时的入口位姿。该方法无需机器人模型或额外训练；每次局部重规划后，若机器人距示教入口的位置偏差超过 10 cm 或朝向偏差超过 10°，入口检查机制（entry gate）便要求机器人转向或后退后重试。在存在定位噪声、且路径、步态调度和感知配置不变的条件下，受扰台沿通过中满足入口容差的比例从 24.1% 升至 88.6%。在接触仿真中，机器人在楼梯前被推离路线后，180 次攀爬均未跌倒，而忽略所记录入口朝向的对照组跌倒 9 次。真机在累计 271 m、海拔跨度 7.0 m 的多障碍赛道上完成全部六次运行，获 2026 Global Open-source AI Challenge 第三名，并成为该赛项唯一全自主完赛的决赛队伍。
key_points_zh: 无碰撞不等于可通行：即使绕行路径没有障碍，入口位姿偏差也可能使固定运动技能在楼梯或台沿处失效。
一次 27 分钟示教为每处地形过渡记录一次成功通过事件；局部重规划后，按 10 cm 和 10° 的容差检查入口位姿，无需机器人模型或额外训练。
定位噪声下，受扰台沿通过的入口达标率从 24.1% 提升至 88.6%；接触仿真中，受推扰动后攀爬 180 次零跌倒，忽略入口朝向时跌倒 9 次。
在被推离路线 1.2 m 的仿真中，重新并入路线后，最终平均离线距离为 0.14 m，相比不执行回归时的 1.10 m 更小，且任务完成率与无扰动时相当。
真机在累计 271 m 的多障碍赛道上六次全部完赛，获 2026 Global Open-source AI Challenge 第三名，并成为该赛项唯一全自主完赛的决赛队伍。
